The workbook generation failed because critical data cells in the 'Task' sheet were empty, causing multiple assertion failures in the verifier.
The test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats failed because expected numeric values were missing (got None). Specifically, cells H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) in the 'Task' worksheet were empty. Avoid leaving these coordinate ranges unpopulated; ensure the logic correctly maps calculated bedflow metrics to the specific rows and columns (H through L) defined in the EXPECTED_TOP and EXPECTED_NET maps.
